purpose: Defines how a future browser automation runner must convert browser observations into sanitized staging summary JSON before validator and model analysis workflows are allowed to process them.
runner_role: collect visible text and high-level error summaries
never pass raw session artifacts directly to model analysis
allowed_observations: high-level console error summaries after redaction
high-level network error summaries after redaction
forbidden_artifacts: server IPs/private endpoints unless explicitly approved
sanitization_requirements: summarize network errors without request/response bodies
do not store cookies or headers
do not attach screenshots/videos/traces unless separately approved
ensure summary passes E2E Staging Summary Validator

required_output: must pass validator before model analysis

handoff_flow: browser runner executes approved route and interactions
browser runner creates sanitized summary JSON
analysis workflow analyzes summary with Qwen/DeepSeek
model report is reviewed before any production/staging decision
stop_conditions: login/auth required and not explicitly approved
rules: this contract does not enable real browser automation
this contract does not add staging URLs
this contract does not authorize credential use
browser automation may be added only after route scope and staging access rules are approved
model analysis receives only sanitized summary JSON
validator must pass before analysis workflow runs
next_steps: create synthetic browser runner summary generator
only then design real staging browser workflow
